baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired قَرَّبَا/قُرْبَانًا and three ق ب ل forms culminate in مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Both sons enter the same outward channel of devotional nearness, but reception divides them. The closing مِن construction relocates the decisive difference from the presented object to the protective orientation of the presenting person.

activation_trace.role: Devotion-directed nearness supplies the shared outward approach and offering.
Reception with satisfaction supplies the repeated relational uptake whose presence and absence divide the pair.
Putting the self in protection supplies the disposition named as the source from whom acceptance occurs.

changed_reading.before: One offering happened to be accepted and the other rejected.
changed_reading.after: The paired offering exposes acceptance as divine relational uptake conditioned by the offerer's protective moral orientation, not as an automatic property of presenting an object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِٱلْحَقِّ frames the one/other asymmetry, and the two قَالَ clauses answer a murder threat with an acceptance criterion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rejected brother converts unequal reception into a personal contest, while the reply removes adjudication from either brother's claim and states a general divine criterion. The truthful report therefore stages rival ways of deciding entitlement: coercive self-assertion versus a criterion neither rival controls.

activation_trace.role: A contest in which each side claims right supplies the latent dispute that the truthful narration adjudicates.
Negotiation over a matter supplies the paired speeches as competing proposals for resolving the asymmetry.
The enemy or matched adversary image supplies the threat's conversion of a brother into a rival to be eliminated.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports jealousy escalating into a threat.
changed_reading.after: The ayah contrasts two jurisdictions: the rejected brother claims an outcome through force, while the accepted brother returns the dispute to a divine criterion of receptivity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَٱتْلُ governs نَبَأَ and بِٱلْحَقِّ before the tightly sequenced إذ/ف/ولم/قال/قال progression.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command does more than transmit an anecdote: its following image asks hearers to track a true report through successive transformations, from approach to unequal reception, then speech, threat, and criterion.

activation_trace.role: Following in succession supplies recitation as leading an audience along an ordered trace.
An arriving, consequential report supplies the transmitted event whose movement must be followed.
Stable correspondence to reality constrains the causal trace as truth rather than rumor.

changed_reading.before: Recite a true report about two sons.
changed_reading.after: Lead the audience along a truth-constrained causal trace showing exactly how an act of approach can turn into a crisis of reception and violence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The accepted brother's protective orientation becomes bodily and procedural: he refuses to extend his hand toward killing, whereas the other's own self makes killing easy and executable. Taqwa now reads as an internal brake that interrupts the translation of injury into outward force.

activation_trace.role: Reception with satisfaction is the outcome whose dispositional condition is being made visible.
A barrier that repels harm supplies taqwa as active interruption rather than a merely named status.
Extending and releasing the hand supplies the concrete action that one brother threatens and the other withholds.
Fear anticipating harm supplies the God-directed concern that blocks reciprocal killing.
The self's making an act easy supplies the opposite internal process: facilitation instead of restraint.
The self's force and character supplies the inner agent that rehearses violence into action.

structural_cues: 5:28 balances 'you extend your hand' against 'I am not extending my hand' with the same ب س ط construction.
5:30 then gives the opposed causal sequence: the self facilitates the killing, so he kills.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withheld hand-extension, God-directed fear, and self-facilitated murder; I infer that the protective disposition named in 5:27 works by interrupting action formation. A live alternative is that 5:28 describes nonretaliation without exhausting the meaning of taqwa.

changed_reading.before: God accepts from people bearing the label 'the Godwary.'
changed_reading.after: God accepts from people whose God-directed protection can halt the hand before grievance is converted into reciprocal violence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's one/other division does not remain a private ritual comparison. Sin returns upon its bearer, literal killing targets a self, and the one slain self is analogically gathered into all people. The mishandled difference in acceptance becomes a mechanism for collective liability.

activation_trace.role: Individual separation supplies the accepted 'one' as a discrete member of the pair.
The other after or apart from the first supplies the relational asymmetry that violence misreads as exclusion.
Unequal reception supplies the initial difference whose social consequences are traced.
A thing returning upon its owner supplies wrongdoing as liability that rebounds rather than transferring cleanly.
Literal taking of life supplies the realized threat and the action generalized by the analogy.
The life-bearing self supplies the singular unit whose violation exceeds a private sibling dispute.
Wholeness without dispersion supplies 'all people' as the full social scale folded into one life.

structural_cues: 5:29 doubles 'my sin and your sin,' resisting a simple transfer of responsibility.
5:32 repeats the one-self/all-people analogy for both killing and giving life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rebounding liability and an explicit one-to-all analogy; I infer that 5:27's one/other comparison is the seed of a social mechanism in which private resentment damages the whole. The alternative is that 5:32 states only a legal valuation of life, not a reading of ritual rejection.

changed_reading.before: Two individuals receive different ritual outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The pair is a scale model: treating another's acceptance as one's own exclusion converts a bounded difference into violence whose liability reaches the human whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commanded following of the report becomes materially pedagogical. A search through earth reveals how concealed bodily consequence is handled; later, guidance itself advances by following prior traces. Recitation therefore makes hearers follow exposed and preserved effects, not merely receive propositions.

activation_trace.role: Following in succession supplies the focus command's trace-like movement.
The arriving consequential report supplies what the audience is led through.
Stirring earth to seek and uncover supplies discovery through a material trace.
Causing something to be seen supplies the raven scene as demonstrative instruction.
Covering something behind visibility supplies the consequence that must first be revealed in order to be concealed responsibly.
Following an effect in succession supplies the later transmission pattern that echoes the focus command.
A remaining mark that indicates what preceded supplies the preserved evidence along which guidance travels.

structural_cues: 5:31 repeats the purpose construction 'to show him how to conceal,' joining revelation to a practical consequence.
5:46 places following directly 'upon their traces,' turning succession into an explicit transmission image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies searching, showing, concealment, following, and remaining traces; I infer that وَٱتْلُ asks the audience to learn by tracking consequences through time. Literal vocal recitation remains the primary live alternative and need not be displaced.

changed_reading.after: Make the audience follow a preserved trail in which hidden consequences become visible and later guidance proceeds upon earlier traces.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's قربان is reclassified by the later sequence: accepted approach is a sought, effortful path under taqwa, while even the whole earth doubled as ransom cannot purchase reception. Quantity of transferred value and quality of approach are separated.

activation_trace.role: Devotional nearness and offering supply the focus's presented means of approach.
Reception with satisfaction supplies the outcome that cannot be reduced to transfer value.
Self-placement in protection supplies the qualitative orientation joined to accepted approach.
Seeking a thing supplies approach as active pursuit rather than possession.
Exerting capacity under difficulty supplies the costly movement along the sought way.
An extended traversable road supplies divine approach as a path of conduct.
Completion without remainder supplies the maximal quantity of earthly value offered.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies the attempted transactional substitution.
The repeated passive non-reception explicitly denies that an earth-sized ransom can secure acceptance.

structural_cues: 5:35 places اتقوا, seek the branchless الوسيلة, and strive in one imperative sequence.
5:36 repeats the focus's passive ق ب ل plus مِن after maximizing the proposed ransom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sought way under taqwa and a maximal ransom that is not accepted; I infer a qualitative-versus-transactional contrast that retroactively classifies the قربان. A live alternative is that 5:36 concerns only the impossibility of post-judgment ransom.

changed_reading.before: The brothers transfer offerings, one of which receives approval.
changed_reading.after: The offering is a mode of approach: receptivity belongs to a protected path of conduct and cannot be bought by increasing the amount transferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The one/other acceptance asymmetry is placed beside differentiated ways, the counterfactual of one community, an explicit test, and a command to race toward goods. Difference in divine allotment becomes a test of response, not authorization for winner-take-all rank or elimination.

activation_trace.role: Individual separation supplies the 'one' distinguished by acceptance.
Otherness after or beside the first supplies the difference that the threat turns into rank.
Unequal reception supplies the comparative event whose proper response is at issue.
Making something into a state supplies differentiated pathways and the unrealized alternative of one community.
A manifest watering place supplies each assigned way as a usable approach rather than a badge of superiority.
A clear path supplies differentiated conduct with intelligible direction.
Singularity and separateness supply the counterfactual unity God did not impose.
A test that makes condition visible supplies the function of receiving different allotments.
Advancing in competition supplies the nonviolent response to difference.
Movement toward beneficial good supplies the field in which comparison should operate.

structural_cues: The focus's مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا/مِنَ ٱلْءَاخَرِ is answered by 5:48's distributive لِكُلٍّ and counterfactual أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً.
5:48 moves directly from testing what each was given to فَٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiated ways, a unity counterfactual, testing, and competition in goods; I infer that this sequence diagnoses the brother's fatal response to differentiated reception. The live alternative is that 5:48 concerns communities only and activates the focus by analogy rather than direct exposition.

changed_reading.before: Acceptance sorts the brothers into a winner and a loser.
changed_reading.after: Differentiated reception tests what each does with difference: the intended competitive field is good action, while murder is the failed attempt to abolish asymmetry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's بِٱلْحَقِّ expands from accurate reporting into an adjudicative discipline. Later actors displace words, accept only a preferred ruling, trade signs for price, and follow desire; the countermechanism is equitable judgment and enacted truth. The brother's threat is thus an early form of outcome-shopping by force.

activation_trace.role: Competing claims to right supply the sibling dispute that must be adjudicated outside either claimant's desire.
Turning something away from its direction supplies textual displacement as manipulation of the adjudicative channel.
Equity and fair apportionment supply the corrective judgment that does not bend to the parties.
Commercial exchange supplies the prohibited conversion of signs into negotiable outcome.
Price as exchange value supplies the small consideration for which truth can be compromised.
Establishing and displaying truth supplies the book and received truth as the operative standard for judgment.
Following in succession supplies the forbidden act of letting judgment trail the parties' preferences.
The self's inclination supplies the pressure that truth-governed judgment must resist.

structural_cues: 5:41 reports the conditional policy 'if you are given this, take it; if not, beware,' making acceptance explicitly outcome-selective.
5:48 repeats بِٱلْحَقِّ and contrasts received truth with following desires.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies manipulated words, selective uptake, equitable judgment, price, truth, and desire; I infer that the focus threat is coercive rejection of an unwanted verdict. The alternative is that the later material regulates public adjudication without specifying the rejected brother's motive.

changed_reading.before: بِٱلْحَقِّ assures that the old story is accurately told.
changed_reading.after: بِٱلْحَقِّ installs a nonnegotiable adjudicative standard: the rejected brother's violence is an attempt to replace an unwelcome verdict with the outcome he wants.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protection is not generalized risk avoidance. The accepted brother fears God and withholds violence; diseased hearts fear an adverse turn and rush into compromising alignment; the later faithful do not fear a blamer's blame. Taqwa is fear ordered toward the right object, freeing action from socially coercive fear.

activation_trace.role: Putting the self in protection supplies the disposition whose fear structure is clarified.
Anticipatory fear supplies the God-directed concern that restrains the hand.
Departure from health and balance supplies the disordered heart in which fear drives compromise.
Fear with apprehensive gravity supplies the stated motive for rushing toward protective affiliation.
An adverse turn or defeat supplies the feared contingency around which diseased hearts organize.
Hiding something inwardly supplies fear's concealed policy before it is exposed.
Regret over what has passed supplies the eventual disclosure that fear chose badly.
The same anticipatory fear is explicitly denied toward social blame.
Blame for a blameworthy act supplies the social pressure that rightly ordered fear can withstand.

structural_cues: 5:28 joins fear of God to refusal of reciprocal hand-extension.
5:52 joins fear of a reversal to rushing and concealed policy, while 5:54 negates fear of blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three differently directed fears and their opposed actions; I infer that taqwa orders fear rather than maximizing caution. The live alternative is that these passages describe separate virtues without defining one common fear mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The accepted are simply those who fear.
changed_reading.after: The accepted protect themselves by fearing the divine criterion more than retaliation, reversal, or social blame, and that ordering frees them from fear-driven violence and compromise.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the guarantee branch is contract-like and form-distant from the ordinary verbal sense of acceptance. It remains anchored in the three ق ب ل forms and coheres with an offered object entering or failing to enter divine charge; downstream prose should present it only as an analogy, not as a lexical replacement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated تُقُبِّلَ/يُتَقَبَّلْ/يَتَقَبَّلُ governs the fate of a قُرْبَان and is followed by a coercive threat.

activation_trace.role: The devotional offering supplies the object presented for relational uptake.
Guaranteeing and taking responsibility supplies an exploratory image of acceptance as taking the offering into charge.
Exposing another to killing supplies the rejected brother's attempt to force consequence when no guarantee is granted.

changed_reading.before: Acceptance means approval of an offering.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, acceptance means that the offering is taken into divine charge; denied that relation, the rejected brother tries to manufacture certainty through coercive consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The literal killing is explicit and confirmed, so it must not be allegorized away. The surprising branch remains useful because 5:30 supplies the self making the act easy before the killing occurs; downstream prose should describe an internal conditioning layer beneath the literal homicide.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ anchors the literal threat, while the same ق ت ل root recurs in its execution.

activation_trace.role: Taming until hardness yields supplies an exploratory image of coercion first worked upon the killer's own resistance.
The self's making the deed easy supplies the internal conditioning step that precedes execution.
The inward faculty of thought and apprehension supplies the site in which murder becomes acceptable to the agent.
Literal taking of life contains the exploratory layer by confirming the bodily act it serves.

changed_reading.before: The brother threatens and then performs a killing.
changed_reading.after: The literal killing includes a prior self-taming process: the agent's inner resistance is softened until lethal coercion becomes an executable act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material analogy: حبط's harmful-food swelling is remote from ritual acceptance. It remains anchored because the focus asks why a presented work is not received and 5:53 explicitly joins حبط to works; downstream prose should mark the metabolic image as exploratory and retain the ordinary sense of works becoming null.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًا followed by unequal ق ب ل makes the fate of a performed offering the focus problem.

activation_trace.role: Devotional offering supplies the work presented for uptake.
Reception with satisfaction supplies the relational metabolism that succeeds for one offering and fails for the other.
Swelling from harmful intake supplies the odd image of outward work entering a system but producing corruption rather than nourishment.
Purposive action supplies the deeds whose outward performance does not secure a viable result.

changed_reading.before: A performed offering is either approved or disapproved.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, nonacceptance resembles failed moral metabolism: outward work is presented, but its inward composition makes uptake corruptive or void rather than nourishing.

strongest_changes: 5:28-30 turns taqwa from a ritual label into a visible interruption of hand-extension and of the self's facilitation of violence.
5:35-36 makes accepted approach qualitative rather than purchasable: a sought path can be accepted where an earth-sized ransom is not.
5:48 recasts the one/other asymmetry as a test that should produce competition in goods instead of winner-take-all violence.
The judgment sequence turns بِٱلْحَقِّ into resistance to manipulated, desired outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: The pericope repeatedly reactivates the focus's own architecture: approach versus ransom, acceptance versus selective uptake, one/other versus differentiated paths, truthful report versus manipulated judgment, and taqwa versus misdirected fear. These recurrences make the murder narrative a compact diagnostic model for ritual, legal, textual, and social receptivity without collapsing those domains into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 5:48's communal plurality is intended to retroact on the brothers or only provides a strong analogical activation.
Whether the guarantee, internal-taming, and metabolic branches should reach downstream prose beyond explicitly exploratory notes.
The focus states acceptance from the protected but does not disclose the offerings' material difference; the packet supports a dispositional filter without proving material irrelevance.
